content_data.project_description: Integrated marketing campaign to boost viewer retention and expand audience reach across streaming and social media platforms through personalized content recommendations and interactive experiences.
content_data.timeline: 9 months with Phase 1 (months 1-3) focusing on research and strategy, Phase 2 (months 4-6) on campaign execution, and Phase 3 (months 7-9) on optimization and analysis
objectives: Increase cross-platform audience engagement by 35% through targeted content strategies
Establish measurable attribution models connecting marketing touchpoints to conversions
deliverables: Post-campaign analysis report with actionable recommendations
Real-time marketing dashboard tracking campaign performance metrics
Interactive mobile app features promoting viewer engagement
success_metrics: 4.2 million incremental impressions across paid and organic channels
20% improvement in content discovery through personalized recommendations
